name: email-actions
description: "Needs attention": turns incoming mail into a short queue of one-click decisions with ready-to-send reply drafts.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 006_email_actions.sql, hot-loads the app).
Triage uses the LLM gateway (LLM_BASE_URL / LLM_API_KEY in .env) — without it, messages still queue for manual review with no drafts.
Replies are sent through the mailbox's own SMTP and always require an explicit execute call.
